skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: New Business
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/New Business. Cement's survey consultant outfit. Snug and durable, the contrast of the hoodie and jacket brings out her vitality. She also gets herself a pair of goggles to match with them.
skins.quote: This is the first time Shana Moleman has left Rim Billiton. She takes off her hard hat for a moment. A survey drone flies high in the sky. This time, it illuminates more than just the darkness of the mineshaft.
